response.sql: WITH scope_averages AS (SELECT u.acctscope AS scope, AVG(f.feerate - f.rebrate) AS average_net_fee_rate, COUNT(f.feerate - f.rebrate) AS averaged_over FROM fees AS f JOIN orders AS o ON f.orderslink = o.recordvault JOIN users AS u ON o.userlink = u.userstamp GROUP BY u.acctscope) SELECT scope, average_net_fee_rate, averaged_over, average_net_fee_rate - AVG(average_net_fee_rate) OVER () AS difference_from_mean_scope_average FROM scope_averages

assumptions.assumption: “How far” means a signed difference from the simple mean of the scope averages.

alternatives.interpretation: “How far” means absolute distance from that mean.
